knowledge_checks.title: Revision Recall: PCA limits
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Restate the purpose of PCA in one sentence and state one claim PCA does not support.
hints: Purpose: reduce dimensionality / summarise correlated structure.
Refuse: automatic causation / invented named business factor.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Revision succeeds only if PCA purpose and honesty still retrieve.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: PCA reduces dimensionality by summarising shared variation in correlated variables into fewer components; it does not by itself prove a causal business driver.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Formula dump without purpose, or causal overclaim.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Checkpoint: discrete match
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. You count the number of defective items in a fixed number of independent inspections with constant defect probability. Which discrete family fits, and why? Name one family that would be a mis-match.
hints: Mis-match example: hypergeometric (without replacement) or geometric (trials to first).
knowledge_checks.explanation: Revision must reconnect situation to discrete family.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Binomial: fixed number of independent trials with constant success probability. Mis-match: hypergeometric if sampling were without replacement from a finite lot.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Checkpoint: continuous placement
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Waiting time until the next claim event under a constant hazard story. Which continuous family fits first, and why? Refuse Normal-by-default in one sentence.
hints: Refuse Normal on support/shape for waiting times.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Revision must keep continuous placement honest.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Exponential: continuous waiting time with memoryless/constant hazard story. Refuse Normal-by-default because waiting times are positive and the Normal support/shape story mismatches.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Normal default; gamma without warrant when exponential is the direct story.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Checkpoint: Alpha association hinge
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book (prior Volume hinge). Skewed variables, outliers, monotone but nonlinear scatter. Choose Pearson, Spearman, or Kendall and justify. State one claim the coefficient does not support.
knowledge_checks.body: Return target: CS1-001 / Alpha Day 3 (1.2.2). Series continuity.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Series continuity requires Alpha association honesty to remain retrievable.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Spearman or Kendall for monotone nonlinear association with outliers; coefficient does not prove causation.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Pearson by habit; causal claim; skipping because 'old Volume.'

reflection.framing: Revision Reflection names the weakest Campaign / series link for future spaced return. Not a chapter summary.
